item.title: 英特尔代工获微软下一代AI芯片订单，将采用18A工艺
item.description: 据报道，英特尔已获得微软的一笔重要订单。微软或将采用英特尔代工的18A或18A-P工艺为其制造下一代AI处理器。这是英特尔代工在18A节点上首次确认的重大外部客户订单。

item.title: [News] Seoul Semiconductor Secures Permanent Injunction in India Following Rulings in Europe and the United States
item.description: Seoul Semiconductor Co., Ltd. (KOSDAQ: 046890, hereinafter 'Seoul') and its affiliate Seoul Viosys Co., Ltd. (KOSDAQ: 092190), global opto-semiconductor technology companies, have obtained a permanent injunction enjoining infringement of Seoul’s opto-semiconductor patents in India, following similar injunction rulings in Europe and the United States.
